title: Personalized Basketball on Hardwood Court Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Transform your bedroom into a personalized court with the Jeminise custom basketball comforter. Perfect for basketball players, fans, and sports enthusiasts, this comforter brings the excitement of the hardwood court directly to your bed with custom name and number options.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own name and number for a truly unique sports-themed bedding set.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • High-Quality Manufacturing: Features advanced environmental protection printing techniques to hold dye and prevent fading, with smooth, fine, and compact edge stitching.
  • Versatile Product Options: Available as either a lightweight Duvet Cover or a cozy Comforter Set.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, dries quickly, and fluffs up beautifully after washing.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D17
Pattern Basketball Print
Theme Basketball
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
